This script documents how all vignette and testing data for the ECLIPSE
package was made. The RNA data is from Zhao et al., Science Immunology, 2021,
as were the all_contig_annotations.csv files. The doi for this paper is
10.1126/sciimmunol.abf6692. The data can be found on GEO with accession GSE167118. 
The following pieces of data are generated below:

1. A vignette Seurat object that has 250 randomly selected cells per sample
from 2 patients with COVID-19, each with a blood and BALF sample 
(4 total samples). 
2. The 4 all_contig_annotations.csv files that hold the TCR contigs for the
1000 cells in the vignette Seurat object.
3. A Seurat object that has cells from sample D5L in clones that had 3 
TCR chains. This is needed for unit testing, as the other objects do not 
lead to all code being checked. It is 1759 cells.
4. A contig file that corresponds to the Seurat object used for unit tests.
5. A test Seurat object that has 5 randomly selected cells per patient from 
2 patients with COVID-19. Only 2 genes are retained in this object to save space.
This object is intended to be a minimal Seurat object that should only be used
to confirm that ECLIPSE will run.
6. The 2 all_contig_annotations.csv files that hold the TCR contigs for the 
10 cells in the test Seurat object.
7. The test Seurat object from #3, but then ECLIPSE is ran on it.
8. Post-QC TCR contigs generated by ECLIPSE on the same cells used to make the
test Seurat object from #3.


To run this script, just change the 4 file paths in the second chunk. Please 
pick a different folder for each path.



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(ECLIPSE)
library(Matrix)
set.seed(16)
```

### Downloading Data
Go to https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE167118 to find the 
data. Please download the all_contig_annotations files from the CD3pos samples 
of Sar03B, Sar03L, Sar05B, and Sar05L. 
Then, move the files to 4 folders called Sar3B, Sar3L, Sar5B, and Sar5L.

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Pre-Processing                               ###
############################################################################

### This generates a Seurat object that ECLIPSE is ran on. This Seurat 
### object is NOT included in the package, as it is far too big. Instead,
### this is used to select cell barcodes that can be used for the vignette
### and testing data.

dirs <- list.files(raw_dir, full.names = TRUE)
dirs <- dirs[str_detect(dirs, "Sar5|Sar3")]

samples <- str_extract(dirs, "Sar.*")

ps <- list()
tcr_dirs <- c()

for (i in 1:length(dirs)) {
  
    print(i)
  
    features_dir <- list.files(dirs[i], pattern = "features", full.names = TRUE)
    features <- read_tsv(features_dir[1], col_names = FALSE)
    features <- features$X1[1:5000] # Just the first 5k genes to save space
    
    matrix_dir <- list.files(dirs[i], pattern = "matrix", full.names = TRUE)
    matrix <- readMM(matrix_dir[1])
    matrix <- matrix[1:length(features), ]
  
    barcode_dir <- list.files(dirs[i], pattern = "barcodes", full.names = TRUE)
    barcodes <- read_tsv(barcode_dir[1], col_names = FALSE)
    barcodes <- barcodes$X1

    tcr_dir <- list.files(dirs[i], pattern = "contig", full.names = TRUE)
    tcr_dirs[i] <- tcr_dir[1]
    
    ps[[i]] <- as.data.frame(matrix)
    colnames(ps[[i]]) <- paste(samples[i], barcodes, sep = "_")
    rownames(ps[[i]]) <- features

}

p <- bind_cols(ps)
rm(ps)

covid <- CreateSeuratObject(p)
rm(p, matrix)
VlnPlot(covid, "nCount_RNA", pt.size = 0)

covid@meta.data <- covid@meta.data %>% mutate(Sample = str_replace(orig.ident, "Sar", "D"))
covid$donor <- as.character(str_replace(covid$Sample, "B|L", ""))
covid$Cell_Barcode <- rownames(covid@meta.data)

covid2 <- covid

covid2$cell_barcode <- str_replace(covid2$Cell_Barcode, "^.*_", "")
covid2@meta.data <- covid2@meta.data %>% mutate(index = case_when(
    Sample == "D3B" ~ 1,
    Sample == "D3L" ~ 2,
    Sample == "D5B" ~ 3,
    Sample == "D5L" ~ 4))

covid2 <- ECLIPSE(covid2,
                         contig_file_paths = tcr_dirs,
                         contig_type = "manual", 
                         batch = "index",
                         donor = "donor",
                         group = "donor",
                         original_barcode = "cell_barcode",
                         format = "none")


```

```{r}
### Making vignette Seurat object and 4 all_contig_files
bc_3b <- as.character(covid2$Cell_Barcode[!is.na(covid2$CTaa) & 
    covid2$Sample == "D3B"])
bc_3l <- as.character(covid2$Cell_Barcode[!is.na(covid2$CTaa) & 
    covid2$Sample == "D3L"])
bc_5b <- as.character(covid2$Cell_Barcode[!is.na(covid2$CTaa) & 
    covid2$Sample == "D5B"])
bc_5l <- as.character(covid2$Cell_Barcode[!is.na(covid2$CTaa) & 
    covid2$Sample == "D5L"])

d3b <- sample(bc_3b, replace = FALSE, size = 250)
d3l <- sample(bc_3l, replace = FALSE, size = 250)
d5b <- sample(bc_5b, replace = FALSE, size = 250)
d5l <- sample(bc_5l, replace = FALSE, size = 250)

keep_bc <- c(d3b, d3l, d5b, d5l)

mini <- subset(covid, Cell_Barcode %in% keep_bc)


d3b_tcr <- read.csv(tcr_dirs[1])
d3l_tcr <- read.csv(tcr_dirs[2])
d5b_tcr <- read.csv(tcr_dirs[3])
d5l_tcr <- read.csv(tcr_dirs[4])

d3b_tcr <- d3b_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(d3b, "^.*_", ""))
d3l_tcr <- d3l_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(d3l, "^.*_", ""))
d5b_tcr <- d5b_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(d5b, "^.*_", ""))
d5l_tcr <- d5l_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(d5l, "^.*_", ""))

# Only if needed
#dir.create(paste0(out_dir, "/D3B"))
#dir.create(paste0(out_dir, "/D3L"))
#dir.create(paste0(out_dir, "/D5B"))
#dir.create(paste0(out_dir, "/D5L"))

write_csv(d3b_tcr, paste0(out_dir, "/D3B/", "all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(d3l_tcr, paste0(out_dir, "/D3L/", "all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(d5b_tcr, paste0(out_dir, "/D5B/", "all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(d5l_tcr, paste0(out_dir, "/D5L/", "all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))


vignette_object <- mini
usethis::use_data(vignette_object, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
### Making another object that has more cells from one sample
### This is needed for the unit tests

keep <- covid2@meta.data %>% filter(Sample == "D5L" & 
    !is.na(CTaa) & str_detect(CTaa, ":::") & cloneCallSource == "VDJdive")

meta <- keep %>% select(nCount_RNA, "Cell_barcode" = Cell_Barcode, donor, Sample)

fake <- matrix(rep(0, nrow(meta) * 2), nrow = 2)
rownames(fake) <- c("CD3E", "CD8A")
fake[1, 1] <- 1
colnames(fake) <- meta$Cell_barcode
data2 <- as(fake, "dgCMatrix")

fake_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(data2, min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)
fake_seurat$Cell_barcode <- rownames(fake_seurat@meta.data)
fake_seurat@meta.data <- fake_seurat@meta.data[,-c(2:3)]
fake_seurat@meta.data <- fake_seurat@meta.data %>% 
    left_join(meta, by = "Cell_barcode", keep = FALSE)

fake_seurat@meta.data <- as.data.frame(fake_seurat@meta.data)
rownames(fake_seurat@meta.data) <- fake_seurat$Cell_barcode

fake_seurat$index <- 1
fake_seurat$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(fake_seurat$Cell_barcode, "^.*_", "")

d5l_tcr <- read.csv(tcr_dirs[4])

d5l_tcr <- d5l_tcr %>% filter(barcode %in% 
    str_replace(meta$Cell_barcode, "^.*_", ""))

# Only if needed
#dir.create(paste0(out_dir2, "/D5L"))

write_csv(d5l_tcr, paste0(out_dir2, "/D5L/", "all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))


unit_test_object <- fake_seurat
usethis::use_data(unit_test_object, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
### Making slim object and contig files for it.
### Note, this is much smaller than the vignette object to increase
### run times. That object is 1000 cells, while this one is only 10 cells.
slim <- subset(covid2, Sample %in% c("D3B", "D5B"))

d3b_bc <- c("Sar3B_AAACGGGCATTGTGCA-1", "Sar3B_AAACGGGAGCAGGTCA-1", 
    "Sar3B_AAAGCAACAAAGGTGC-1", "Sar3B_AACCATGAGTCATGCT-1",
    "Sar3B_AACGTTGAGTGGGCTA-1")
d5b_bc <- c("Sar5B_GAGTCCGTCACCACCT-1", "Sar5B_GATCGCGAGCGTTCCG-1", 
    "Sar5B_GATGCTAGTAGCCTAT-1", "Sar5B_GCACTCTCACGTGAGA-1", 
    "Sar5B_GCATGTAAGTACGCGA-1")

contigs_d3b <- read.csv(tcr_dirs[1])
contigs_d5b <- read.csv(tcr_dirs[3])

sum(d3b_bc %in% slim$Cell_Barcode)
sum(d5b_bc %in% slim$Cell_Barcode)

contigs_d3b <- contigs_d3b %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(d3b_bc, "^.*_", ""))
contigs_d5b <- contigs_d5b %>% filter(barcode %in% str_replace(d5b_bc, "^.*_", ""))

slim2 <- subset(covid2, Cell_Barcode %in% c(d3b_bc, d5b_bc) & 
    Sample %in% c("D3B", "D5B"))
                
nrow(slim2@meta.data)

meta <- slim2@meta.data %>% select("Cell_barcode" = Cell_Barcode, donor, index)
meta$index[meta$index == 1] <- 1
meta$index[meta$index == 3] <- 2

data <- LayerData(slim2, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[c("ENSG00000172116", "ENSG00000153563"), ]
slim3 <- CreateSeuratObject(data)
slim3@meta.data <- slim3@meta.data %>% 
    select(-nFeature_RNA) %>%
    mutate(Cell_barcode = rownames(slim3@meta.data))

slim3@meta.data <- slim3@meta.data %>% left_join(meta, by = "Cell_barcode")
slim3@meta.data <- as.data.frame(slim3@meta.data)
rownames(slim3@meta.data) <- slim3$Cell_barcode
slim3$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(slim3$Cell_barcode, "^.*_", "")

test_seurat <- slim3


write_csv(contigs_d3b, paste0(out_dir3, "/D3B_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))
write_csv(contigs_d5b, paste0(out_dir3, "/D5B_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))

usethis::use_data(test_seurat, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#### Making the post-QC contigs and test Seurat object after 
### ECLIPSE was ran on it
contig_files <- c(paste0(out_dir3, "/D3B_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"),
        paste0(out_dir3, "/D5B_all_contig_annotations.csv.gz"))

data('test_seurat')


cd8_tcr <- ECLIPSE(contig_file_paths = contig_files, 
    contig_type = "manual", 
    seurat_object = test_seurat, 
    batch = "index", 
    donor = "donor", 
    group = "donor", 
    original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", 
    combineTcrArgs = list(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),
    format = "None")

test_seurat_with_tcr <- cd8_tcr
usethis::use_data(test_seurat_with_tcr, overwrite = TRUE)

post_qc_contigs <- ECLIPSE(contig_file_paths = contig_files, 
    contig_type = "manual", 
    seurat_object = test_seurat, 
    batch = "index", 
    donor = "donor", 
    group = "donor", 
    original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", 
    combineTcrArgs = list(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),
    returnFilteredContigs = TRUE,
    format = "None")

usethis::use_data(post_qc_contigs, overwrite = TRUE)
```
